title: Effects of a Hemp Product on the Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics of Clopidogrel
official: Effects of a Hemp Product on the Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics of Clopidogrel
summary: The goal of this clinical trial is to determine how two different doses of cannabidiol (CBD), given as a hemp product, change the blood concentrations of the drug clopidogrel in the body. Results will be used to help design future studies and to assist healthcare providers in informing their patients about the safe use of CBD.

interventions.name: Cannabidiol in the form of hemp
